understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked + in each level, while avoiding spike tiles and continuing until the game is won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Horizontal MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT actions shift the player, after which gravity automatically carries the player until landing on support, hitting a hazard, or reaching the goal. Gravity direction is indicated by the state, and landing previews identify destinations and passages to new sections. CLICK removes a specified clickable breakable tile without moving the player, useful for opening gravity paths. Landing on spikes ends an attempt; each level allows two attempts, and UNDO can revert the previous action.
